summary: In almost every state a person can register before turning eighteen if they will be eighteen by Election Day.
realLife: Some states also let seventeen-year-olds who will be 18 by Election Day vote in primaries.
sources: USAGov, Who can and cannot vote: https://www.usa.gov/who-can-vote
inGame: the registration record; needs: the primary rule for 17-year-olds.
